descriptionChirho: To come to know or learn something, gaining cognitive awareness of a fact or truth.
To recognize or identify a person or thing, perceiving who or what someone/something is.
To acknowledge or accept something as true or authoritative, a volitional act of recognition.
To know thoroughly or completely, with the epi- prefix intensifying the sense of full comprehension.
Passive sense: to be known or recognized by others, whether partially or fully.
